relations.subject: Lati Rinpoche
relations.evidence: At the age of fifteen, he enrolled in Gaden Shartse Norling College, one of the 'great three' Gelukpa university monasteries of Tibet. In 1959, Lati Rinpoche sat for the Geshe Lharmapa examination

relations.subject: Lati Rinpoche
relations.evidence: In 1960, Lati Rinpoche joined the tantric college in Lhasa, and started intensive study in Tantra.

relations.subject: Lati Rinpoche
relations.evidence: On arrival in Dharamsala, he was appointed as the spiritual advisor to  the 14th Dalai Lama.

relations.subject: Lati Rinpoche
relations.evidence: From 1976, Lati Rinpoche taught at the Namgyal Gomba (the 14th Dalai Lama's personal monastery).

relations.subject: Lati Rinpoche
relations.object: Shartse Norling College of Gaden Monastery
relations.evidence: In the same year, he was appointed as the Abbot of the Shartse Norling College of Gaden Monastery]
